* The TCR is a complex of T cell antigen receptors that recognize antigens. The variable β-sequence (Vβ) is a unique portion of the TCR that is involved in antigen recognition.

* The binding of TSST-1 to the Vβ region of the TCR leads to an excessive and inappropriate activation of T cells, resulting in the release of large amounts of cytokines and the development of TSS symptoms.

```B```
